ns2:course.label: Intro Hospitality Management
ns2:course.description: Explore the foodservice aspect of the hospitality industry by assisting Hospitality Management seniors in the Bevier Cafe/Spice Box taking either FSHN 441 or FSHN 443. Course covers the planning, production, and service of meals in specialized settings.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: There may be a fee for Class Materials for some sections of this course.
